snippet.title: Treasure Flea Market – Official English Preview Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Treasure Flea Market, a gentle story-driven simulation game where forgotten objects find new life.
Join Sho, a quiet boy who can hear the voices of objects, and his robot partner Zero as they explore Junk Mountain, collect soulful items, and rebuild a small town through a flea market.
A warm, hand-drawn style, soft fantasy, and heartfelt encounters await.
Where forgotten objects shine again.

[iOS] https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1638057718?mt=8
[Android] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.happygrace.garafree
